rows.en: Render: "To think I'd come back here again..."
Ryord: "L-Lord Render... Are we really taking on
Liebhofen with just us?"
Kinari: "Don't worry.
Lord Bernst is on our side.
He'll come help if we're in danger."
Goh: "Commander... It's nearly time."
Render: "All right. Our only objective is Liebhofen.
Once we've sunk it, they'll be like a bird with its wings torn off..."
Goh: "Commander..."
Render: "I'm sorry for dragging you into this..."
Goh: "No. I lost someone dear to me that day too.
In that ridiculous training exercise..."
Render: "For the Spirit Mech pilots...
Heh, because they were there..."
Goh: "...Let's go."
Sisk: "Huh? What?!"
Touya: "Hey, that's..."
Render: "I'm counting on your support."
Kinari: "R-roger!"
Render: "Don't overdo it. As planned, Goh and I
will strike Liebhofen. In the meantime, use the Gadrans
to finish off the Spirit Mechs! All right... Let's go!"
Xiujian: "...It seems we're their target."
Touya: "Then I'll take them on!"
Ai: "Come to think of it, where are Lodis and the others?"
Celica: "I think they're at the palace..."
Fain: "There's no need to trouble His Majesty or my master!
We can handle the likes of them ourselves!"
Touya: "...Yeah."
Rishuna: "I'm sorry, but we..."
Touya: "I know. We can handle this ourselves.
Just watch from there. Oh, I'd be happy
if you could cheer us on."
Rishuna: "Y-yes!"
Touya: "See you."
Ai: "Touya, I'm doing things my own way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll be acting
on my own."
Clovis: "I'm acting independently. I'll leave your side to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I still can't entrust my life to you.
I'll do things my own way."
Xiujian: "...I have no intention of following your orders.
I'll act as I see fit."
Celica: "Sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice
does not yet dwell within you! I cannot obey someone like that!
Therefore, I shall pursue my own justice! That is all!"
Gen: "I'll show you how much I've grown!
So I'm going to act on my own. See you!"
Melvi: "Big Brother, I've got a little idea.
So I'll act on my own."
Melissa: "This time, I'd like to act independently."
Kururu: "I'll fight however I like."
Leone: "I'm not sure I can follow
your orders properly, Touya. So I'll act freely this time."
Clovis: "I suppose it's too late to apologize now?"
Render: "Heh... Thanks to that worthless exercise
you held that day, my wife and son..."
Clovis: "So you're going to kill me?"
Render: "Until recently, that's what I intended.
But I've thought of another way... To make you
feel the same as I do..."
Clovis: "Don't tell me... Liebhofen?!"
Render: "...Heh."
Clovis: "Tch..."
Arthur: "We're the ones you're after. Stop dragging
innocent people into this!"
Render: "Heh... Innocent...? Hehehe..."
Arthur: "What's so funny?!"
Render: "...That's precisely my objective.
Just as you took my wife and son from me,
I'll take your precious comrades from you!"
Arthur: "You don't mean Liebhofen?!"
Render: "...Heh."
Arthur: "I won't let you!"
Goh: "Lord Render! Eject!"
Render: "Guh... At least... At least let me land one blow..."
Goh: "Lord Render!"
Render: "At least... At least one blow..."
Derock: "W-whoaaaa! Th-this is baaaaaad!"
Derock: "W-whoaaaa! Sefiaaaaa!"
Sisk: "G-Gaiozon?!"
Bernst: "I can't have them dying just yet...
Your actions are a nuisance."
Ymir: "...What does that mean?"
Render: "Guh! I'm not done!! Uooooooooh!!"
Derock: "Nwaaaah! He's making a suicide charge!
Th-this time we're really dooooomed!!"
Bernst: "...How foolish..."
Render: "...I'm sorry... Fisel..."
Derock: "Wahyahyahyah! Bwah!"
Baren: "..."
Derock: "I'm gonna diiiiiie!! Fggh..."
Baren: "...Be quiet."
Goh: "Lord Render..."
Goh: "Guh... Everyone, withdraw!"
Goh: "...Lord Render..."
Goh: "Lord Render, I'm sorry.
It seems we can't go any farther."
Render: "Yes. You've fought well. Leave the rest to me."
Goh: "Lord Render...?"
Render: "Don't worry. Go back ahead of me and wait."
Goh: "...Yes, sir! Good luck!"

review_batches.context: Entire 104-row member read, relevant Render/Sefia library evidence checked. Render/Goh plan revenge on Liebhofen, Kinari assumes Bernst support, team independent-action alternatives and Clovis/Arthur confrontation.
review_batches.decisions: Keep loss attribution and grief as characters' account, unknown Goh loved one's gender/relationship, Gadran versus Spirit Mech targets, emotional refusal versus fixed team chronology, full names and ejection request. No concrete real attack engineering supplied.

row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o001d2.l00: Are-we-taking-on-Liebhofen question split across rows; not Royal Knights or palace target.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00208.l02: Kinari expects Bernst help; later intervention contradicts assumed support, not narrator promise.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o0026f.l01: Wingless bird metaphor for opponents after ship sunk, no actual sabotage specification.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o002eb.l00: Goh lost someone dear, no gender or biological relationship supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o002eb.l01: In-that-exercise deliberate fragment linked to prior loss.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00326.l00: For-pilots and because-they-existed deliberately unfinished resentful association; don't invent new motive details.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o0049b.l00: Render requests support, not offers it to Kinari.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o004c9.l00: Render/Goh attack ship while others use Gadrans against Spirit Mechs, no target reversal.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00544.l00: Xiujian infers their objective, not proof he knows full revenge plan.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o005bf.l00: His Majesty Lodis and master Rest context, not vague enemy leaders.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00616.l00: Rishuna's unfinished apology refers combat restraint established earlier, no new incapacity invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00633.l01: Touya invites watching/cheering, not orders disobedience to Grauzer.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00740.l00: Independent-action rows are conditional alternatives, not all speakers necessarily mutinying together.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o007c9.l00: Clovis acts alone and leaves Touya's side to him; not orders Touya to follow Clovis.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o008f2.l00: Burning soul of justice is Fain rhetoric, not a named game stat or literal soul condition.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o009ce.l00: Big Brother familiar Touya address, no biological sibling relationship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00a9d.l00: Leone's uncertainty about following orders, not definitive incompetence.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00c1d.l00: Clovis asks whether apology too late, not confirms absolution.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00c3e.l01: Wife-and-son deliberately unfinished loss statement, details not graphically expanded.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00ca0.l01: New revenge approach now targeting companions, not prior aim simply kill Clovis.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00d53.l00: Arthur calls crew uninvolved/innocent, Render treats that as point of revenge.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00de0.l02: Take-comrades threat retains force, no graphic means added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o00fd4.l00: Separate repeated incomplete one-blow wish retained.

review_batches.context: Entire member read. Ship panic, Gaiozon/Bernst intervention and Render charge, Fisel apology, Baren/Derock gag and withdrawal/remaining-behind alternatives.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve Sefia as Derock's canonical addressed person, not Selphin mech. Fisel is provisional name with identity/relationship/gender unconfirmed. Fictional suicide-charge description not expanded into actual technique, mechanism or death narration. Alternate withdrawal stored separately.

row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o01070.l00: Sefia canonical name, character 110 female fiancee; source stretch not reinterpreted as Selphin mech.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o010c5.l00: Bernst wants them alive for now; not proof allegiance to Touya or support for Render.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o01171.l00: Suicide charge fictional combat threat, no real method supplied or expanded.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o011d9.l00: Fisel direct name address only; not automatically wife/son identity despite surrounding grief. Editorial spelling after reference search found no official rendering.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o01207.l00: Derock's strained/comic cry distinct from earlier panic; not ordinary laughter at deaths.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o01241.l00: I'm-gonna-die panic claim, not narrator-confirmed actual death; muffled sound retained.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o0126d.l00: Baren tersely quiets Derock; exact physical gag action not invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o013b1.l00: Alternate remaining-behind exchange not assumed after same preceding terminal event.
row_decisions.scenario.s_025.o01424.l00: Render orders Goh back ahead, not offers own immediate retreat.
